question.nlq: Could you tell me which products are the best-selling?
evidence: A best-selling product is defined as the product that has generated the highest total revenue, i.e., the sum of the product prices for all order items associated with that product.
A best-selling product is defined as the product with the highest number of times sold, i.e., the greatest count of order items associated with that product.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: Use the definition of best-selling product based on total revenue generated.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH product_revenue AS (
  SELECT p."product_id", p."product_name", SUM(p."product_price") AS total_revenue
  FROM "Order_Items" oi
  JOIN "Products" p ON oi."product_id" = p."product_id"
  GROUP BY p."product_id", p."product_name"
)
SELECT pr."product_name"
FROM product_revenue pr
WHERE pr.total_revenue = (
  SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM product_revenue
);

meanings.hidden_knowledge: Use the definition of best-selling product based on the number of times sold.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT "product_name"
FROM "Products"
WHERE "product_id" IN (
    SELECT "product_id"
    FROM "Order_Items"
    GROUP BY "product_id"
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT MAX(cnt)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM "Order_Items"
            GROUP BY "product_id"
        )
    )
);
